name: Jake Barber Joins Rep. Eric Burlison’s Congressional Staff
summary: PARADIGM reported on November 6, 2026 that Jake Barber joined Representative Eric Burlison’s staff to assist with UAP investigations. Spokesperson Nate Lucas confirmed the appointment to the outlet. The precise start date and job title are not independently established; employment does not substantiate Barber’s separate extraordinary claims.
